# Baby

> A local-first baby health and nutrition tracker PWA for parents in Sweden,
> built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework. Parents keep a simple daily food
> regimen (from about 6 months) that the app checks against age- and
> size-appropriate recommendations, record weight / length / head
> circumference on the WHO growth standards, log diapers with one tap, and
> follow the Swedish childhood vaccination programme. The document is stored
> on-device as JSON, with an optional copy synced to the user's own Dropbox
>. Every assessment is derived from the document at read time.

- App: https://baby.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/baby
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Today: the child's age, a one-tap diaper log (pee / poo / both, time
  recorded automatically) with today's tally, and the headline answers —
  is the food regimen still sufficient, the latest growth reading, and the
  next vaccination
- Food: a daily regimen of the foods the baby typically gets, each with
  calories (required) and optional iron, vitamin D and fat details, compared
  against the recommendations for the child's current age and weight; the
  app says when the child has outgrown the regimen
- Growth: weight, length and head circumference plotted on the WHO growth
  standards as SD lines, with the trend emphasised over any single reading,
  and the mid-parental target height
- Vaccinations: the Swedish childhood vaccination timeline — given, due and
  upcoming doses — plus vaccinations outside the general programme
- Settings: light/dark theme, cloud sync, JSON backup and restore
- No account, no server, no analytics; installable and fully offline
